name: IndiaAI Mission (2024)
owner: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: IndiaAI Mission (approved by the Union Cabinet on March 7, 2024). India's national artificial intelligence strategy framework, comprising NITI Aayog's foundational 2018 National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence (#AIforAll) and the Union Cabinet-approved 2024 IndiaAI Mission implemented by Digital India Corporation under MeitY across seven pillars (Compute Capacity, Innovation Centre, Datasets Platform, Application Development, FutureSkills, Startup Financing, and Safe & Trusted AI).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (meity.gov.in) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (meity.gov.in).
